title: California voters defeat billionaire tax proposal that divided Democrats
content: The novel proposal would have charged billionaires a one-time 5% tax on most of their overall wealth, including their ownership in companies.

title: France accuses Iran of cyber 'sabotage' in fridge attacks
content: France says Iranian military hackers took over refrigeration controllers at around 700 different retail sites last month, turning up temperatures in the middle of the night and spoiling millions of dollars' worth of food.

title: Supreme Court says border wall construction can continue in west Texas
content: The Trump administration filed an emergency relief request with the high court earlier in October asking for the construction to continue while a lawsuit over the plan moves forward.

title: Thomas Massie files articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth
content: The articles accuse Hegseth of "high crimes and misdemeanors," including for waging war against Iran in violation of the War Powers Resolution.

title: Thick smog shrouds New Delhi after Diwali firecrackers add to seasonal pollution
content: New Delhi, home to over 30 million people, regularly ranks among the world's most polluted areas during winter, with pollution worsening in late October and November.

title: British comedian Russell Brand sentenced to over 10 years for rape and sexual assault
content: Russell Brand, who became a celebrity darling in the early 2000s, was found guilty on one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault in a case brought by six women.

title: Congress is back after GOP's midterm defeat. And, Trump appoints new chief of staff
content: Republicans have just weeks left of control of Congress. Here's what to expect. And, Trump has appointed Stephen Miller as his new chief of staff, signaling his readiness to confront his opposition.

title: Why a South Korean city is turning to a U.S. college to outsmart AI?
content: Through civic participation and liberal education, South Korean educators hope to "quietly stitch the fabric of our democracy…before it unravels beyond repair."

title: Democrats won big on issues like immigration. But ICE still has the money
content: Following Tuesday's "blue wave," Democrats have vowed to reign in ICE's power. What could they actually accomplish?

title: On wild Cumberland Island, a land swap proposal stirs controversy
content: Visitors, ecologists, park rangers and residents all love this wild barrier island off the coast of southern Georgia. But they have different ideas of how to best protect it.
